description: Two related packages record the start of housing construction. The urban source covers centres of at least 10,000 people and defines a start by beginning basement foundations. The municipal source distinguishes housing type and defines footing completion or the equivalent stage for buildings without basements. Metadata start dates are 1948 for the urban series and 1972 for municipal data, whose end is 2021. CSV, spreadsheet, XML and JSON representations are listed. These are starts, not completed units or occupancy. Definitions and geographic coverage remain separate in this curator grouping. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown. A third companion gives preliminary monthly housing starts for Calgary, Edmonton, Lethbridge, Red Deer, Medicine Hat, Wood Buffalo and Grande Prairie metropolitan/agglomeration areas. Native coverage is 2007–November 2023 with CSV and PDF descriptors. These preliminary observations retain their particular seven-centre geography and revision status; no numerical equivalence to the older urban/municipal series is asserted.
